real: what is this writing implying: " (∗/∗∗/∗∗∗ for p<0.05/0.01/0.001)"
prev_agent: Not a rendering error. `App.~\ref{app:setup}` correctly resolves to "App. A" because `\label{app:setup}` is attached to the first appendix section (`\section{Experimental Setup Details}` at line 1057, immediately after `\appendix` at line 1045). LaTeX numbers appendix sections with letters, so it renders as **A**. The semicolon after "A" is just punctuation continuing the sentence ("…in App. A; on acceptance we release…"). Both the reference and the punctuation are intentional and correct.
